name: vscode-claude-sound-notifier
description: Plays a sound when Claude Code needs your approval or finishes a response.

claudeSoundNotifier.enabled.description: Play sounds for Claude Code events.

claudeSoundNotifier.volume.description: Playback volume (0-100). Ignored on Windows and when falling back to aplay.

claudeSoundNotifier.repeat.description: How many times each sound plays per event.

enumDescriptions: Only react to Claude sessions running inside this window's workspace folders.
React to every Claude session on this machine, including terminal sessions elsewhere.
claudeSoundNotifier.scope.description: Which Claude Code sessions this window reacts to.

claudeSoundNotifier.onlyWhenWindowUnfocu.description: Only play sounds when this VS Code window is not focused.

claudeSoundNotifier.permission.enabled.description: Play a sound when Claude is waiting for your approval.

claudeSoundNotifier.permission.sound.description: "default" for the built-in sound, or an absolute path to a .wav file.

claudeSoundNotifier.done.enabled.description: Play a sound when Claude finishes a response.

claudeSoundNotifier.done.sound.description: "default" for the built-in sound, or an absolute path to a .wav file.

claudeSoundNotifier.idle.enabled.description: Play a sound when Claude has been waiting for your input for a while.

claudeSoundNotifier.idle.sound.description: "default" for the built-in sound, or an absolute path to a .wav file.
